text: Now these are the people of the province who came up from the captivity of the exiles carried away to Babylon (confusion by mixing) by Nebuchadnezzar (may Nebo protect the crown) its king. They returned to Jerusalem (city of peace) and Judah (praised), each to his own town,

accompanied by Zerubbabel (sown in Babylon), Jeshua (he is saved), Nehemiah (YHWH comforts), Seraiah (YHWH is ruler), Reelaiah (bearer of YHWH), Mordecai (little man), Bilshan (in slander), Mispar (number), Bigvai (in my bodies), Rehum (compassion), and Baanah <Neh 7:7>. This is the count of the men of Israel (he wrestles with God):
the descendants of Parosh (flea), 2,172;
the descendants of Shephatiah (YHWH has judged), 372;
the descendants of Arah (traveller), 775;
the descendants of Pahath-moab (pit of Moab) (through the line of Jeshua (he is saved) and Joab (YHWH is father)), 2,812;
the descendants of Elam (eternity), 1,254;
the descendants of Zattu (brightness of him), 945;
the descendants of Zaccai (pure), 760;
the descendants of Bani (Binnui), 642;
the descendants of Bebai (my cavities), 623;
the descendants of Azgad (Gad is mighty), 1,222;
the descendants of Adonikam (my lord arose), 666;
the descendants of Bigvai (in my bodies), 2,056;
the descendants of Adin (delicate), 454;
the descendants of Ater (binder) (through Hezekiah (YHWH has made strong)), 98;
the descendants of Bezai (conqueror), 323;
the descendants of Jorah (Hariph), 112;
the descendants of Hashum (rich), 223;
the descendants of Gibbar (Gibeon), 95;
the men \the sons/ of Bethlehem (house of bread), 123;
the men of Netophah (dropping), 56;
the men of Anathoth (answers to prayer), 128;
the descendants of Azmaveth (Beth-azmaveth), 42;
the men of Kiriath-jearim (city of forests), Chephirah (lioness), and Beeroth (wells), 743;
the men of Ramah (hill) and Geba, 621;
the men of Michmash (hidden), 122;
the men of Bethel (house of God) and Ai (heap of ruins), 223;
the descendants of Nebo (prophet), 52;
the descendants of Magbish (congregating), 156;
the descendants of the other Elam (of West Elam), 1,254;
the descendants of Harim (dedicated), 320;
the men of Lod (travail), Hadid (sharp), and Ono (vigorous), 725;
the men of Jericho (city of palms), 345;
and the descendants of Senaah (thorny), 3,630.
The priests: The descendants of Jedaiah (YHWH has known) (through the house of Jeshua (he is saved)), 973;
the descendants of Immer (he has said), 1,052;
the descendants of Pashhur (freedom), 1,247;
and the descendants of Harim (dedicated), 1,017.
The Levites: the descendants of Jeshua (he is saved) and Kadmiel (God is the ancient one) (through the line of Hodaviah (Hodevah) 74.
The singers: the descendants of Asaph (gatherer), 128.

The gatekeepers: the descendants of Shallum (retribution), the descendants of Ater (binder), the descendants of Talmon (oppressor), the descendants of Akkub (insidious), the descendants of Hatita (exploring), and the descendants of Shobai (glorious), 139 in all.
The temple servants \The Nethinim/: the descendants of Ziha (parched), the descendants of Hasupha (stripped), the descendants of Tabbaoth (rings),
the descendants of Keros (ankle), the descendants of Siaha (Sia), the descendants of Padon (ransom),
the descendants of Lebanah (moon-white), the descendants of Hagabah (locust), the descendants of Akkub (insidious),
the descendants of Hagab (locust), the descendants of Shalmai [Shamlai], the descendants of Hanan (he is merciful),
the descendants of Giddel (very great), the descendants of Gahar (hiding place), the descendants of Reaiah (YHWH has seen),
the descendants of Rezin (firm), the descendants of Nekoda (distinguished), the descendants of Gazzam (devouring),
the descendants of Uzza (strength), the descendants of Paseah (limper), the descendants of Besai (my treading),
the descendants of Asnah (I shall be hated), the descendants of Meunim (habitations), the descendants of Nephusim (Nephushesim),
the descendants of Bakbuk (bottle), the descendants of Hakupha (bent), the descendants of Harhur (inflammation),
the descendants of Bazluth (Bazlith), the descendants of Mehida (famous / noble), the descendants of Harsha (mute),
the descendants of Barkos (the son cut off), the descendants of Sisera (battle array), the descendants of Temah (laughter),
the descendants of Neziah (pre-eminent), and the descendants of Hatipha (seized).
The descendants of the servants of Solomon (peace): the descendants of Sotai (changeful), the descendants of Hassophereth (writing), the descendants of Peruda (Perida),
the descendants of Jaala (ascending), the descendants of Darkon (scatterer), the descendants of Giddel (very great),
the descendants of Shephatiah (YHWH has judged), the descendants of Hattil (doubtful), the descendants of Pochereth-hazzebaim (here the cutting off), and the descendants of Ami (Amon).
The temple servants and descendants of the servants of Solomon (peace) numbered 392 in all.

The following came up from Tel-melah (mound of salt), Tel-harsha (mound of the deaf mute), Cherub (blessing), Addan (Addon), and Immer (he has said), but they could not prove that their families were descended from Israel (he wrestles with God):
the descendants of Delaiah (YHWH has drawn), the descendants of Tobiah (YHWH is good), and the descendants of Nekoda (distinguished), 652 in all.

And from among the priests: the descendants of Hobaiah (YHWH has hidden), the descendants of Hakkoz (thorn), and the descendants of Barzillai (my iron) (who had married a daughter of Barzillai the Gileadite (rocky region) and was called by their name).
These men searched for their family records, but they could not find them and so were excluded from the priesthood as unclean.
The governor ordered them not to eat the most holy things until there was a priest to consult the Urim (lights) and Thummim \Lights and Perfections/.
The whole assembly numbered 42,360,
in addition to their 7,337 menservants and maidservants, as well as their 200 male and female singers.
They had 736 horses, 245 mules,
435 camels, and 6,720 donkeys.
When they arrived at the house of the LORD {YHWH} in Jerusalem (city of peace), some of the heads of the families gave freewill offerings to rebuild the house of God {Elohim} on its original site.
According to their ability, they gave to the treasury for this work 61,000 darics of gold <1,129.7 lb / 512.4 kg>, 5,000 minas of silver <3.14 t / 2.85 mt>, and 100 priestly garments.

So the priests, the Levites, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants, along with some of the people, settled in their own towns; and the rest of the Israelites (all Israel) settled in their towns.
